title: Launch Conductor: Schedule, Stakeholder Handshake, and Contingency Runbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: produce a single operational playbook ("Launch Conductor") that sequences blog, email, social, webinar, and release notes activities across Marketing, Developer Relations, Product, Design, and Eng. The goal is to eliminate ambiguity about cutoffs, asset ownership, contingency paths (e.g., blocking regressions or late-performance regressions), and post-launch monitoring ownership. This ticket coordinates the schedule, stakeholder handshake cadence, and a short contingency runbook for the next product release.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated timeline exported to shared calendar with explicit owner for each asset
A one-page stakeholder handshake matrix with primary/backup and communication channel
Release notes draft published to Confluence and linked to final blog draft
A contingency runbook with three escalation tiers and rollback/feature-flag paths
All cross-functional owners have acknowledged responsibilities in the Launch Conductor doc
tasks: Draft Master Timeline (PM) — include publish windows, embargo times, and dry-run slots
Map Asset Owners (PM + Design) — blog draft, hero assets, screenshots, social copy, webinar slides
Coordinate Dry Run for Webinar (DevRel + Product) — schedule practice and tech check
Lock Release Notes (ENG + PM) — extract notable changes and callouts, link to regressions
Set Monitoring & Rollback Hooks (Eng Reliability) — post-launch dashboards, alert thresholds
Prepare Email Segmentation Plan (Growth) — audience, CTA, and throttling plan
Define Emergency Paths (PM) — feature flagging, downgraded announcement language, and hold procedures
Create Final Publish Checklist and Handoff (PM) — include UTC timestamps and who presses publish
